text:
ali: Noticed a handful of tenants with quota spikes but no matching request volume. Suspect duplicate route headers inflating attribution.

bina: On staging I saw events with repeated x-route-hint entries in the same envelope.

charlie: Quick root cause candidates: SDK retry appending header OR proxy merging headers.

dana: I pulled a raw event sample: `x-route-hint: tenant=acme` and another identical line in the same event. Publisher didn't collapse them.

ali: Confirmed py-sdk v0.14.2 retry wrapper appends instead of replacing. Minimal fix: set header to string on retry.

bina: Can we deploy a short-term ingestion dedupe while the SDK patch rolls out? 5s window should stop noise.

ops-bot: Deployed staging dedupe lambda (5s sliding window). Suppressing spam alerts for test tenants.

charlie: I'll add a normalization step (lowercase + trim) before hashing dedupe keys; prevents casing/whitespace escapes.

dana: Product wants badge in console when dedupe is active and an audit event for customers. Jen approved via DM.

ali: I'll open the py-sdk PR now and canary in 3h. Link will be posted here.

bina: Also adding an ingestion unit test that replays retry traces and asserts single attribution.

ops-bot: Prod dedupe scheduled in 30m for a 20m smoke. Alerts adjusted.

charlie: Nice work. After stabilizing we'll run a short retro and add idempotency tests to SDK release checklist.

ali: PR: https://git.redwood/sam/py-sdk/pull/421 — header replace + test.
